name: Leading-edge AI compute (datacenter scale)
description: The capability to deploy leading-edge AI training and inference compute at datacenter scale: thousands of accelerator modules per cluster, delivered on schedule, at a cost and power envelope that sustains frontier-model buildout. Structural container per ADR-0004; products under it are alternative architectures that satisfy this demand.

targetContext.targetScale: 10k–100k+ accelerator modules per buildout wave, multi-GW datacenter campuses
targetContext.targetPerformance: Leading-edge training/inference perf-per-watt and per-module HBM bandwidth at the current process/packaging frontier
targetContext.targetUseCase: Frontier AI training clusters and high-volume inference fleets
targetContext.region: Global (fabrication concentrated in East Asia; deployment US/global)

name: AI accelerator module (leading-edge logic + HBM on 2.5D advanced package)
description: Flagship AI accelerator module architecture: a leading-edge logic die (or die pair) co-packaged with high-bandwidth-memory stacks on a 2.5D/3D advanced package (silicon interposer / local interconnect bridge class), carried on a high-layer-count organic substrate, with high-speed electrical/optical interconnect off-module, multi-hundred-watt power delivery, and liquid-class thermal management. This is the architecture shipping in volume in 2024–2026 datacenter accelerators.

targetContext.targetPerformance: Frontier-node logic + maximum-bandwidth memory co-package; module power 700W–1.4kW class
targetContext.region: Global demand; manufacturing concentrated in Taiwan/Korea/Japan supply chains
